title: TikTok Notification
blurb: Short, bright and engineered by the app that reorganised global attention spans. This alert means somebody liked something, or somebody replied, or — far more often — the algorithm has simply decided it has been too long since you last opened it. TikTok's whole design philosophy is compressed into a sound that gives you no information whatsoever and still gets a response. Play it near anyone under thirty and watch an involuntary phone check ripple across the room within half a second. Devastatingly effective as a prank, and slightly depressing as a piece of behavioural evidence.
